name: raw-complete-first-nonselected
query: MATCH (n) WHERE toLower(coalesce(n.class, '')) CONTAINS $term OR toLower(coalesce(n.name, '')) CONTAINS $term OR toLower(coalesce(n.caller_class, '')) CONTAINS $term OR toLower(coalesce(n.caller_name, '')) CONTAINS $term OR toLower(coalesce(n.callee_class, '')) CONTAINS $term OR toLower(coalesce(n.callee_name, '')) CONTAINS $term RETURN DISTINCT n.name LIMIT 1
